Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: planning fee share, smallest fee, markup, target margin, deposit share, reply hours and the days that trigger a warning.
Fill Team, Clients and Venues once. Every other sheet picks names from them, and the phones fill in for the message links.
Set your prices on Packages: budget per guest, planning fee share and smallest fee for each event type and tier.
Enter every new enquiry on Enquiries. The three tier prices, the budget fit, the reply check and the follow-up check fill in by themselves.
Log each contact on Follow-up Log and each venue hold or site visit on Venue Holds. The days left and the expiry flag show which hold to extend.
Send proposals from the Proposal Price calculator, record them on Proposals with their lines on Proposal Items, and chase the ones flagged.
Use Date Availability to answer the question, is my date free, before you promise a date to a client.
Record each signed contract on Contracts, each change on Contract Amendments, and track signatures and deposits on their sheets.
Move lost enquiries to Lost Enquiries with the reason and the price gap, and read the lessons every quarter.
Fill Marketing by Source and Referral Partners to see the cost per booking of every channel.
Use the 14 calculators before you quote: price, venue spend, payments, win chance, budget fit, fee, break-even, peak dates, counter-offer, source cost, cancellation, timing, capacity.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read Sales Dashboard and Charts every week: enquiries, proposals, signed value, conversion by source and lost enquiries.
